A1.justification: Both PDFs describe OpenVid-1M and MVDiT. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A.1–A.5 support reliable comparison despite pagination and layout shifts.

before.justification: v1 reports original dataset statistics, text-to-video evaluations, training analyses, and ablations in Figures 3 and 5 and Tables 2–5, plus qualitative comparisons in the appendix.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including quantitative evaluations, ablations, and appendix visual comparisons.

M1.justification: The data-curation pipeline and MVDiT architecture remain unchanged, including multimodal self-attention, temporal attention, and cross-attention. The corrected UniMatch citation does not document an algorithm change.

E1.justification: Training sources, OpenVid-1M/OpenVidHD-0.4M, WebVid-10M and Panda-50M comparisons, and the EvalCrafter benchmark remain unchanged. InternVid is newly discussed as related work but is not used in training or evaluation.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains LaVie, Show-1, OpenSora-V1.1, OpenSoraPlan-V1.1, Latte, VideoCrafter, Modelscope, and Pika. The academic and commercial comparators in Appendix A.3 are also unchanged; InternVid is not an evaluated comparator.

E3.justification: Both versions use the same 700 evaluation prompts, metrics, resolutions, preprocessing, and training settings. The 50K-step dataset comparisons and Table 5 controls of 0.6M training examples at 256×256 are retained.

E4.justification: Tables 4–5 retain the same architecture, resolution, training-data, and filtering-stage ablations. Figure 5's convergence analyses and the appendix qualitative comparisons and examples are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate and training-curve reporting. Neither adds seed information, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: The numerical entries in Tables 2–5, plotted results, and qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, Table 2's Ours row retains VQA_A=73.46, VQA_T=68.58, and Blip_bleu=23.45.

T1.justification: The filtering-set definitions and MVDiT equations (1)–(7) are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: OpenVid-1M, its 433K-video HD subset, MVDiT, and their claimed effectiveness. The added InternVid discussion does not redefine these core contributions.

C2.justification: Section 2 newly attributes low-quality InternVid clips to its emphasis on aesthetics over dynamic consistency and clarity and its 720p resolution cap. This adds a limited explanatory argument; interpretations of the reported experiments and limitations concerning physical realism and long-duration dynamics remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, filtering thresholds, initialization, optimizer, frame sampling, and hardware disclosures are unchanged. Appendix A.5 retains the same hosting, licensing, and maintenance information, and the external access links are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds InternVid and contrasts its scale, task focus, curation, and resolution with OpenVid-1M. The UniMatch reference is also replaced: v1 cites a semi-supervised segmentation paper, whereas v2 cites Unifying flow, stereo and depth estimation, matching the stated optical-flow application.

P1.justification: The related-work dataset discussion receives a limited expansion. Title capitalization and 1080p notation are standardized, while section order and nearly all other prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Existing displays are repositioned: Figure 3 moves from page 4 to page 5, and Table 2 from page 7 to page 8. Appendix table and figure placement also shifts, without new graphics or substantive redesign of the displays.

improvement.justification: v2 improves research context by discussing InternVid and corrects the mismatched UniMatch reference, improving attribution and traceability. The scientific evidence remains unchanged. The added InternVid quality contrast is not experimentally tested in the paper, so the gain is limited to context and citation accuracy.
